meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后，Claude执行Bash命令时会自动经过rtk压缩，处理git、cargo、pytest等开发命令通常能省下60–90%的token。
howto.when: 当Claude运行任何Bash命令时自动触发；例如git、cargo、pytest等开发命令会先经rtk压缩再执行。

say.text: 运行git status查看当前文件状态。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude’s Bash commands are automatically routed through rtk, which compresses them before execution. On common dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, etc.) this typically saves 60–90% of tokens.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever Claude is about to run a Bash command (e.g., git, cargo, pytest): rtk compresses the command first.

say_en.text: Run git status to see the current state.
say_en.note: This Bash command is compressed by rtk first.

say_en.text: Build the project with cargo build.
Run pytest to check the results.
say_en.note: pytest also goes through rtk automatically.
